item.title: G-Player 0.4.5
item.description:
• G-Player speaks Ukrainian. With macOS set to Ukrainian, the whole app is in Ukrainian: library, spaces, Get Apps, Settings, menus, alerts and the messages G-Player shows when something goes wrong. English stays the main language and is what every other Mac gets. Reports for Share What Worked… and the logs stay in English. Translators: see Localization/README.md; make l10n lists what isn't translated yet.
  • A new icon: a play mark with the letter G.
  • Get Apps offers Steam and Epic. GOG Galaxy and Ubisoft Connect were never checked from start to finish on Apple Silicon, so they are no longer offered. A space you set up for one keeps working as before.
